description: This file defines a Java interface named ShippingQuoteModule that specifies methods for validating configuration, retrieving custom module configuration, and obtaining shipping quotes related to shipping and delivery processes within a commerce system.

classes.name: ShippingQuoteModule
classes.description: A Java interface that declares methods for validating shipping module configurations, retrieving custom configurations, and obtaining shipping quotes based on various parameters.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the shipping module configuration for a specific merchant store, potentially throwing an IntegrationException if validation fails.

methods.name: getCustomModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves custom integration configuration for a merchant store, may throw an IntegrationException.

methods.name: getShippingQuotes
methods.description: Calculates and returns a list of shipping options based on input package details, order total, delivery information, store info, configuration, module, shipping configuration, and locale.
